result.analyst_notes: Long-form, first-person voice from Chairman Buffett, mixing aspirational principles with factual explanation. Shareholders are addressed first and most often, framed as owner-partners. Commitments are often hedged ('we will try', 'we hope') and sometimes absolute ('we will never'). Candor and conservatism are repeated themes. Stakeholders such as customers, DEI, and environment are absent.
